titre: Drifting Ferrari F40 at Zoute Grand Prix: Police draw up charge sheets
extrait: During the Zoute Grand Prix in the jet set seaside resort of Knokke-Heist (West Flanders) police drew up charge sheets after the driver of a bright red Ferrari F40 was seen to be executing inappropriate driving. On the seafront and at the luxury resort La Réserve, the driver of the Ferrari began drifting and doing doughnuts. “Every car, whether it is taking part in the Zoute Grand Prix or not, must comply with the Highway Code” the police say. The organisers, too, were less than impressed by the ‘stunt driving’.
resume: Lors du Zoute Grand Prix à Knokke-Heist, le conducteur d'une Ferrari F40 rouge a reçu une mise en demeure après avoir effectué des dérives et des figures non autorisées, violant le code de la route.

resume: Selon GAMS Belgium, environ 9 800 filles et femmes à Bruxelles ont subi ou risquent une mutilation génitale féminine; une manifestation est prévue samedi contre les violences basées sur le genre.

titre: Belgian parliament to legislate to allow police to enter homes to facilitate undocumented migrant removals
extrait: Belgian police will soon be able, in conjunction with the Immigration Office (DVZ), to enter the homes of undocumented migrants who pose a threat to public order or national security. This is set out in a bill drafted by the Belgian Asylum and Migration Minister, Anneleen Van Bossuyt (Flemish nationalist N-VA), and Justice Minister Annelies Verlinden (Flemish Christian democrat CD&V), which has now been approved by the House Home Affairs Committee. The proposal still needs to be OKed during a plenary session of the lower house of the Belgian parliament.
resume: Le parlement belge approuvera prochainement une loi permettant à la police d'entrer au domicile des migrants sans papiers pour faciliter leur expulsion, proposée par les ministres Van Bossuyt et Verlinden.

titre: Earth quakes in West Flanders for first time since 2011

titre: Plans for a McDonald’s in Flemish village triggers deluge of complaints
extrait: In Schoonbroek, part of the Antwerp municipality of Retie, more than 1,500 objections have already been collected against the arrival of American fast-food chain McDonald’s. The campaign group ‘Ruimte voor Schoonbroek’ (Space for Schoonbroek) believes the proposed site is unsuitable. “The 10,000 m² site is also out of keeping with our quiet, liveable village,” says Paul Quirynen. In two weeks’ time, the objections will be handed in at the local council meeting.
resume: Plus de 1 500 objections ont été collectées contre l'implantation d'un McDonald's à Schoonbroek (Anvers), le groupe de campagne jugeant le site inapproprié.

titre: National Day of Action and public sector strike to cause disruption on Friday 9 October and Monday 12 October
extrait: Christian union ACV and the ABVV, its socialist counterpart, are staging yet another National Day of Action on Friday to mark their opposition to the policies of the De Wever I government. On Monday strike action is being held across the public sector. Expect disruption: Brussels local transport company MIVB, Flemish local transport company De Lijn and Brussels Airport will be hit on Friday and schools and rail services will be affected on Monday.
resume: Les syndicats chrétien ACV et socialiste ABVV organisent une journée d'action nationale le 9 octobre et une grève du secteur public le 12 octobre contre les politiques du gouvernement De Wever. Des perturbations sont attendues aux transports en commun bruxellois et flamands, à l'aéroport de Bruxelles et aux services ferroviaires.
